# `regulatory_agenda_items`

One durable registry item per RIN. Scope is an evidence-state classification, not identity: official `Routine and Frequent` priority supports `recurring`; exactly one linked action supports `single_observed`; every other case remains `unresolved`.

- **Parquet file:** `materialized/ontology/latest.json` (atomic snapshot manifest)
- **Supported by MCP `query_sql` after first publication:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agenda_item_id` | `VARCHAR` | Canonical agenda-item IRI `urn:rkaf:us:rin:<RIN>`. Primary key. |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Regulation Identifier Number identifying this durable agenda item. |
| `scope_status` | `VARCHAR` | `recurring`, `single_observed`, or `unresolved`. |
| `scope_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit rule that produced `scope_status`; multiplicity alone never proves recurrence. |
| `linked_proceeding_count` | `VARCHAR` | Count of distinct independently identified Proceedings with direct action evidence for this RIN. |
| `observation_count` | `VARCHAR` | Count of edition-specific Unified Agenda observations in the source snapshot. |
| `latest_agenda_edition` | `VARCHAR` | Lexically latest `YYYYMM` Unified Agenda edition observed for the item. |
| `first_seen` | `VARCHAR` | Earliest dated agenda or action evidence observed for the RIN. |
| `last_seen` | `VARCHAR` | Latest dated agenda or action evidence observed for the RIN. |
| `method` | `VARCHAR` | Derivation method; `deterministic`. |
| `actor_id` | `VARCHAR` | Versioned agenda-item classification ruleset. |
| `run_id` | `VARCHAR` | Pipeline run identifier. |
| `asserted_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC assertion timestamp. |
| `supersedes_id` | `VARCHAR` | Prior assertion revised by this row, when applicable. |
